description: Set who may read a program: its visibility and the WHOLE lists of reader people and teams, replacing the stored ones. Read them first with anyforge_get_program_access and send its `access.revision` as `ifRevision` (the access revision, not the program's); a stale one is refused with `program_access_modified`. Private: only the listed people, members of the listed teams, the program's lead and owner and its roster read it. Only the program's lead or owner, or a company Owner, may change it. Making a program private needs private programs to be available in the workspace. Opening a private program makes everything in it visible to every member, so a first attempt is refused with `declassification_unconfirmed`: show the person that and repeat with `confirmDeclassify: true` only after they confirm. Requires `write` scope and a key that acts as a person.

confirmDeclassify.description: Opening a private program: true only after a person confirmed, following a `declassification_unconfirmed` refusal. Never on a first attempt.

ifRevision.description: The `access.revision` you read (the access revision, not the program's `revision`).

memberUids.description: The whole list of people (member uids) who may read it. Omitted = none.

teamIds.description: The whole list of teams whose direct members may read it. Omitted = none.

visibility.description: open: every member reads it. private: only its readers.

name: anyforge_set_program_access
title: Set program access
